text:
name: Agent Validation
run-name: agent-${{ inputs.job_id }}-${{ inputs.expected_sha }}

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      job_id:
        description: Unique 32-character hexadecimal validation ID
        required: true
        type: string
      expected_sha:
        description: Full immutable candidate commit SHA
        required: true
        type: string
      task_id:
        description: Existing 32-character task ID; blank for baseline
        required: false
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: agent-validation-${{ inputs.job_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  validate:
    permissions:
      contents: read
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    env:
      CI: 'true'
      EXPECTED_SHA: ${{ inputs.expected_sha }}
      JOB_ID: ${{ inputs.job_id }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout pinned revision
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4, verified 2026-10-02
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.expected_sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify pinned revision
        shell: bash
        run: |
          [[ "$EXPECTED_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
          [[ "$JOB_ID" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{32}$ ]]
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_SHA"
          test "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" = 'Bot-IpMan/marketing_report_studio'
          test "$GITHUB_REF" = 'refs/heads/main'
      - name: Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4, verified 2026-10-02
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - name: Require browser
        shell: bash
        run: |
          browser="$(command -v google-chrome || command -v google-chrome-stable || command -v chromium || command -v chromium-browser || true)"
          test -n "$browser"
          echo "E2E_BROWSER=$browser" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Build
        run: npm run build
      - name: Unit and smoke tests
        run: npm test
      - name: Agent guard tests
        run: npm run test:agent
      - name: Strict PDF fixtures
        run: npm run qa:pdf:strict
      - name: Strict browser E2E
        run: npm run e2e:strict

  publish:
    if: always()
    needs: [validate]
    permissions:
      contents: write
      checks: write
      actions: read
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout trusted publisher
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Publish candidate check and result
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          VALIDATE_RESULT: ${{ needs.validate.result }}
        run: python3 scripts/agent/run.py publish
